option_relations.rationale: Acute on Chronic Liver Failure (ACLF) is a clinical syndrome, not a specific disease entity that can be directly mapped to the provided leaf which is a specific viral infection.

Acute-on-chronic liver failure due to acute hepatitis C virus infection describes a clinical syndrome with an etiology, but the provided leaf is only 'Acute hepatitis C virus infection', not the combined syndrome.
Hepatitis C virus infection is a broader category that includes acute hepatitis C virus infection as a subtype.
Acute Hepatitis C Virus (HCV) Infection is clinically equivalent to 'Acute hepatitis C virus infection'.
